summary: @ornikar/eslint-plugin-ornikar preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundle
details: package.json declares preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is variable-name-obfuscated and, on install, downloads a pinned Bun release archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods +x, and invokes the Bun binary against sibling math_init.js in the package directory. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (header "// @bun @bun-cjs") using rotated string-array + numeric-code-array (n7gIxM) obfuscation decoded via a shift routine (WV8StW), so its behavior is opaque to Node-based review and only ever runs under the Bun binary dropped at install time. The package is advertised as an ESLint plugin; ESLint plugins are consumed by Node-based lint tooling and have no functional need for a second language runtime or for executing a large opaque payload at install. The combination of obfuscated loader, install-time acquisition of an alternate runtime, and execution of an obfuscated payload under that runtime gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on every installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
